summary: Return tint and shared Emoji key morph improvements, private templates and profile controls.

changes.title: Return accent
changes.detail: Plain Return and contextual actions use the chosen accent even on neutral-background layouts. Other keys and transparency retain existing styling.

changes.title: Shared Emoji key transitions
changes.detail: Return/Search, Delete and Space morph using their actual geometry; immediate native ownership, transparent-buffer cleanup and a less aggressive frame-gap fallback reduce flicker.

changes.title: Dynamic text templates
changes.detail: User-created encrypted snippets with date, time and cursor placeholders.

changes.title: Clipboard search
changes.detail: Interruptible clear-icon motion and no repetitive full-list reveal.
